"""Frozen RoboPaint instance: exact raster-derived brush passes, one continuous contact.
Run python /app/output/gen.py. Saves a replayable joint target sequence using Session.
"""
import os, time, json, math, argparse
import numpy as np, cv2
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
from rcb_brush import Session, WangBrush
OUT='/app/output'; PIX=.22185986964255727

def plan(width=2.,spacing=6,margin=0.):
    target=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<100
    cfg=json.load(open('/app/instance.json'))['brush']; b=WangBrush(cfg)
    dep=(width+.3)/1.187/1000; d=b.drag_of(dep)*1000; off=b.offset_of(dep)*1000
    xs=np.arange(-int(np.ceil(d/PIX))-1,2)*PIX
    ys=np.arange(-int(np.ceil(width/2/PIX))-1,int(np.ceil(width/2/PIX))+2)*PIX
    xx,yy=np.meshgrid(xs,ys); k=(xx<=0)&(-xx<=d*(1-4*yy**2/width**2))
    mask=target.astype(np.uint8)
    if margin>0:
        mask=(ndi.distance_transform_edt(target)*PIX>=margin).astype(np.uint8)
    E=cv2.erode(mask,k.astype(np.uint8),anchor=(len(xs)-2,len(ys)//2),borderType=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)>0
    lines=[]
    for v in range(242,780,spacing):
        lab,n=ndi.label(E[v]); slices=ndi.find_objects(lab)
        for sl in slices:
            lo,hi=sl[0].start,sl[0].stop-1
            if hi-lo>=1:lines.append([lo,hi,v])
    return np.array(lines),dep,b,target

def build_sequence(lines,dep,b,speed=.02,ramp=14,light=.00015):
    seq=[]
    def move(x,y,z,n=None):
        tar=np.array([x,y,z])
        if not seq:seq.append(tar);return
        prev=seq[-1]
        if n is None:
            # space in root millimetres, and handle displacement from the depth-dependent offset
            L=np.linalg.norm(tar[:2]-prev[:2])/1000
            n=max(1,int(np.ceil(L/(speed/20))))
        for t in np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:]:seq.append(prev+(tar-prev)*t)
    for a,c,v in lines:
        x=(a+.5)*PIX; end=(c+.5)*PIX; y=(v+.5)*PIX
        move(x,y,light)
        # let residual XY velocity settle before ramping pressure
        move(x,y,light,5)
        move(x,y,dep,ramp)
        move(end,y,dep)
        move(end,y,light,ramp)
    move(*seq[-1][:2],light,10)
    return np.array(seq)

def execute(seq,s,b,light=.00015):
    p=s.primitives(); p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.024],speed=.1,settle=15)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.045],speed=.08,settle=5)
    first=seq[0]; w=s.geo.mm_to_world(*first[:2])
    p['move_tip']([*w,.04],speed=.1,settle=10)
    p['move_tip']([*w,.02-light],speed=.025,settle=15)
    des=np.zeros((len(seq),3))
    for i,r in enumerate(seq):des[i]=[*s.geo.mm_to_world(r[0]+b.offset_of(r[2])*1000,r[1]),.02-r[2]]
    bias=np.zeros(3); last=des[0]; t0=time.time()
    for i,ds in enumerate(des):
        nex=des[min(i+1,len(des)-1)]; meas=s.tip_pose()[0]
        if i:bias=np.clip(bias+.08*(last-meas),-.001,.001)
        cmd=ds+2*(nex-ds)+bias
        q,ok,e=s.ik(cmd)
        if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK',i,cmd,e))
        s.step(q);last=ds
        if i%1000==0: print('step',i,'/',len(des),'elapsed',round(time.time()-t0,1),'contacts',len(s.strokes()),'press',s.press_depth(),'bias',bias,flush=True)
    pos=s.tip_pose()[0];p['move_tip']([*pos[:2],.05],speed=.025,settle=15)

def local_metrics(ink,target):
    ink=ink>=.5
    dt=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~target)
    bi=ink & ~ndi.binary_erosion(ink); bt=target & ~ndi.binary_erosion(target)
    dbt=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~bt);dbi=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~bi)
    bp=np.mean(dbt[bi]*PIX<=1); br=np.mean(dbi[bt]*PIX<=1)
    return {'iou':float((ink&target).sum()/(ink|target).sum()),'precision':float((ink&target).sum()/ink.sum()),'recall':float((ink&target).sum()/target.sum()),'stray':float((ink&(dt*PIX>1)).sum()/target.sum()),'boundary_f':float(2*bp*br/(bp+br))}

if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--width',type=float,default=2);ap.add_argument('--spacing',type=int,default=6);ap.add_argument('--ramp',type=int,default=14);ap.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=.02);ap.add_argument('--margin',type=float,default=0);ap.add_argument('--name',default='trajectory');ap.add_argument('--score',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
    lines,dep,b,target=plan(args.width,args.spacing,args.margin)
    seq=build_sequence(lines,dep,b,args.speed,args.ramp)
    print('plan',len(lines),'lines',len(seq),'steps',flush=True)
    s=Session('/app/instance.json',render=False);s.record_start();execute(seq,s,b)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,f'{OUT}/{args.name}.npz',meta=vars(args))
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(f'{OUT}/{args.name}.png');np.save(f'{OUT}/{args.name}_ink.npy',s.ink())
    print('local',local_metrics(s.ink(),target),'steps',s.n_steps,'state',s.state_sha(),'strokes',len(s.strokes()),s.painter.stats,flush=True)
    if args.score:
        print('score',s.score(),flush=True)
